answer: One enclave yields one identity, which means 971 clones would need 889 physical devices plus the relic attestation each must still earn by work. The raven check rejects duplicated quotes outright, which converts a software attack into a hardware purchasing problem. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
